title: Quantifying Adaptability in Pre-trained Language Models with 500 Tasks
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on benchmarking the technical adaptability of language models across various linguistic and factual tasks. While it mentions fairness, equity, and biases from pre-training in the conclusion and impact statement, these are presented as implications of the work rather than being a core component of the evaluation framework or the tasks themselves. The benchmark does not include tasks designed to evaluate morals, ethics, or religion.
